# Hostelworld

> > Hostelworld is the world's leading hostel and budget accommodation booking platform, connecting backpackers and travelers with hostels, B&Bs, and guesthouses across Europe, Asia, and beyond.

Hostelworld offers online bookings, ratings, and reviews for budget travelers seeking hostels, bed and breakfasts, and youth hostels worldwide. The platform features properties across major destinations including Rome, Berlin, Amsterdam, London, and cities throughout Asia, with a focus on backpacker communities and sustainable travel initiatives like Climate Neutral certification.
